full_name: Shimon Attie | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2006–2007 Arts Mildred Londa Weisman Fellow Independent Artist
bio: Shimon Attie is an installation artist and photographer who uses contemporary media to animate sites with images of their lost histories.
